entries.title: Orbis desktop app
entries.description: Download Orbis for Mac, Windows, or Linux from the landing page. You get native notifications, an unread count on the app icon, the option to start Orbis when you log in, and updates that install themselves.

entries.title: Remove and ban community members
entries.description: Community admins can remove members, ban people from the community, and lift bans later from community settings.

entries.title: Share forum threads to the community feed
entries.description: Admins can set a forum category to post its new threads to the community feed, so more members see them. You can also attach a link to forum threads and replies.

entries.title: Admin-only forum sections and categories
entries.description: Admins can limit a forum section or category so only they can start new threads there, which is handy for announcements.

entries.title: Icons and colors for forum categories
entries.description: Admins can give each forum category its own icon and color, making the forum easier to scan.

entries.title: Install guide after downloading the desktop app
entries.description: After you download the desktop app, a short guide walks you through opening it for the first time on your system.
